findings.title: Clicking the Journal nav link while a search is active clears the URL but keeps the search box and filtered results
findings.expected: Opening /journal from the nav shows the unfiltered latest entries with an empty search box, matching the URL
findings.actual: URL becomes /journal with no q, but the search box still says 'courgette' and only Courgette entries are listed

findings.title: Malformed journal list response is rendered as fake entries on the Journal page
findings.expected: A non-list response shows an error, not search results
findings.actual: A string body is shown as '4 entries match' with four entries whose plant, date and text are blank or '–'
findings.evidence: {"items":4,"text":["Journal","The latest notes from across the garden, newest first.","Write in a plant's journal","Search","Clear search","4 entries match","–","–","–","–","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"]} | {"items":4,"text":["Journal","The latest notes from across the garden, newest first.","Write in a plant's journal","Search","Clear search","4 entries match","–","–","–","–","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"]}

findings.title: Malformed journal response on plant detail shows fake entries with Edit/Delete buttons
findings.expected: An error saying the journal could not be loaded
findings.actual: 4 blank entries dated '–' with Edit and Delete buttons labelled 'entry from –', and no alert

findings.title: Navigating to Journal while its request hangs leaves the old page shown with no loading indicator
findings.expected: The Journal page shows 'Loading entries…' or an error
findings.actual: After 13 s the URL is /journal but the Plants page is still displayed with no sign of loading

findings.title: Failed 'Add entry' error stays visible after later successful journal actions
findings.expected: The add-entry error clears when the user does something else that succeeds, or at least when the form is cleared
findings.actual: 'Injected 500' stays above the new-entry form after the text is cleared and another entry is edited and saved
